Reading Kitāb al-Ṭahārah

All 283 numbered entries, 281–563, and 339 commentary and structural units are included. Original Arabic opens first; Vocalised Arabic shows the supplied commentary draft in the same window. Select a passage for its English directly below, or use Study mode.

Review status

Commentary source: D1–D3 Release 01, 22 October 2026. All Arabic, English, vocalised drafts, stable IDs and editorial notes are preserved. D4 editorial review and E scholarly verification remain pending.

Hadith Arabic follows B1/B2 lexical Review 04. Choose Vocalised Arabic · draft for the Version 10 reconciliation. The approved Editorial Vocalisation 03 covers all 283 entries. Original Arabic preserves B1 Review 04 exactly. The vocalised layer applies archive errata H518/H528 and retains the previously approved H519/H556 corrections. Supplied proof statuses, competing readings and the open H335/H356 decisions remain in the notes. Independent vowel proof remains pending. Hadith English is the supplied C1 working translation, labelled Robson verification pending. Shared source translations remain complete at each mapped entry.

Mirqāt volume 2, PDF pages 3–246, is the Arabic authority. Bushrā is a comparison witness. Recorded variants, unresolved H335 wording, and printed reference anomalies remain unchanged.

Controls and local reading

Search finds Arabic, English, hadith numbers and stable passage IDs. Enter or Space activates a selected commentary passage; Escape closes its translation. Original and Vocalised Arabic buttons work with the keyboard. Contents includes the book introduction, chapter and section headings, and every hadith.

The file works offline without external scripts or fonts. Text size and the last selected passage are remembered in this browser where storage is available. Original Arabic is selected again on reload. Use the book links to move between Kitāb al-ʿIlm, Kitāb al-Fitan and Kitāb al-Ṭahārah.
